XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for Moodle mod geniai

TABLE.NAME: aacurachat
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores AACURA chatbot roleplay activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: topiccode
FIELD.COMMENT: Selected Topic code from the Topic Library

FIELD.NAME: scenariolist
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON or CSV list of scenario codes enabled for this activity instance

FIELD.NAME: scenariocode
FIELD.COMMENT: Default starting scenario code for this activity

FIELD.NAME: allow_persona_switch
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether students can switch between enabled scenarios in this activity

FIELD.NAME: grading_mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Multi-scenario grading policy: single_highest, single_latest, or all_average

FIELD.NAME: min_turns
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-activity override for min student turns before grading (0 = inherit)

FIELD.NAME: parent_intensity
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-activity persona assertiveness level override (empty = inherit)

FIELD.NAME: generation_case
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-activity AI generation profile override (empty = site default)

FIELD.NAME: custom_prompt_template
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional per-activity persona system prompt override

FIELD.NAME: custom_eval_template
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional per-activity rubric evaluation prompt override
